provenance.licenceNote: CC BY 4.0: may be copied, adapted and shipped with credit to the Global Meteor Network and the two citations. data/local/ is still git-ignored; whether to ship a subset is an owner decision (T-056).

release.note: bytes: the sum over the monthly files; sha256: of the lines "YYYYMM:<file sha256>", one per file, in the order listed

provenance.filter: column "IAU No" equals the IAU shower number; rows with e >= 1 (hyperbolic or parabolic) or a <= 0 or an empty element dropped
provenance.layoutNote: Positions are looked up from the header rows (names over units) on every run; the tool throws if a column is missing, repeated, or the data fail the range and node-vs-solar-longitude checks.
provenance.plane: ecliptic-j2000 (the elements as GMN publishes them; the check in the facts compares the node with the solar longitude); semi-major axis in AU

columnNotes.sheetRow: line number in the monthly file
columnNotes.convergenceAngleDeg: Qc, the maximum convergence angle between the stations that saw the meteor
columnNotes.pairsFlag: always 0: GMN has no double-entry flag

shipped.note: Shipped copy of the fetched file: same records and header, without the columns the app never reads (the pairs flag is always 0 for GMN). Rows are stored column by column, the epoch as differences from the row before, to send fewer bytes; every value is unchanged. Credit: Global Meteor Network, CC BY 4.0.
